column7: Refuses a body chunk past the 4 MiB response or 8 MiB preview budget: a size cap on an untrusted peer's input, the decision every other budget function delegates to.
Charges every chunk of a streamed (SSE) answer before the decoder sees it and ends the stream at the first refused chunk; a mistake would let an over-budget SSE answer through.
Reads a whole body through metered and refuses it past either budget before it is held or parsed.
Picks the metered read for a non-2xx body when a budget is set; a wrong branch would read an unbounded error body from an untrusted peer.
Picks the metered read for a 2xx JSON body when a budget is set; a wrong branch would read an unbounded body.
Builds the budget with its two limits; a swapped or wrong limit would silently loosen the cap.
Installs the budget on the preview transport; if it were not called the preview would read unbounded bodies.
